parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a pen, typically made of plastic. It is cylindrical and fits over the writing tip to protect it from drying out or leaking.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the pen tip and prevents ink from drying. It may also clip onto a pocket or notebook for portability.
parts.Movement_description: It can be removed or attached to the pen body by pulling or snapping into place.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the pen, made of plastic and designed to house the ink cartridge and provide a comfortable grip.
parts.Functional_description: The base body holds the ink refill and provides the main gripping area for writing. It ensures structural integrity and ergonomics.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the main handle while writing.
